problem:
Problem description
- There is a single-period feed blending planning problem for one animal.
- Define $$\mathcal{I}$$ as the set of feed types, indexed by $$i \in \mathcal{I}$$, and define $$\mathcal{R}$$ as the set of nutrient types, indexed by $$r \in \mathcal{R}$$.
- Each feed type $$i$$ has a known nutrient composition $$a_{r i}$$, meaning the amount of nutrient $$r$$ provided by one unit of feed $$i$$.
- Each feed type $$i$$ has a known unit cost $$c_i$$.
- Each nutrient type $$r$$ has a minimum required daily amount $$d_r$$ that must be covered by the selected feed mix.
- The planning goal is to choose nonnegative feed quantities $$x_i$$ so that all nutritional requirements are satisfied at minimum total cost.
- Required business constraints:
  - The selected quantity of each feed type must be nonnegative.
  - The total supplied amount of each nutrient must meet or exceed its required daily minimum.
  - All nutrient requirements must be satisfied at the same time by the same feed mix.
  - The total purchasing cost of the selected feeds must be minimized.
- A solution is represented by:
  - $$x_i$$: the chosen quantity of feed type $$i$$ for each $$i \in \mathcal{I}$$.
  - $$z$$: the minimum total cost of the selected feed mix.

Input Format
{
  "num_feeds": "$$N$$",
  "num_nutrients": "$$R$$",
  "requirements": {
    "shape": "$$R$$",
    "meaning": "vector $$d_r$$ of minimum daily nutrient requirements for each $$r \\in \\mathcal{R}$$",
    "type": "array of nonnegative numbers"
  },
  "nutrient_content": {
    "shape": "$$R \\times N$$",
    "meaning": "matrix $$A=[a_{r i}]$$ where $$a_{r i}$$ is the amount of nutrient $$r$$ in one unit of feed $$i$$",
    "type": "2D array of nonnegative numbers"
  },
  "unit_cost": {
    "shape": "$$N$$",
    "meaning": "vector $$c_i$$ of unit costs for each feed type $$i \\in \\mathcal{I}$$",
    "type": "array of nonnegative numbers"
  },
  "quantity_unit": {
    "meaning": "common unit used for feed quantities and nutrient composition basis"
  }
}

Output Format
{
  "feed_quantities": {
    "shape": "$$N$$",
    "meaning": "optimal quantity $$x_i$$ chosen for each feed type $$i \\in \\mathcal{I}$$",
    "type": "array of nonnegative numbers"
  },
  "total_cost": {
    "meaning": "optimal objective value $$z$$, equal to the minimum total cost of the selected feed mix",
    "type": "number"
  }
}

Example(s)

Input 1
{
  "num_feeds": 5,
  "num_nutrients": 3,
  "requirements": [700, 30, 100],
  "nutrient_content": [
    [3, 2, 1, 6, 18],
    [1, 0.5, 0.2, 2, 0.5],
    [0.5, 1, 0.2, 2, 0.8]
  ],
  "unit_cost": [0.2, 0.7, 0.4, 0.3, 0.8],
  "quantity_unit": "feed mass unit as used in the source data"
}

parameters.name: minimum_nutrient_requirement
parameters.description: Minimum required daily amount for each nutrient

parameters.name: nutrient_content
parameters.description: Amount of nutrient provided by one unit of each feed type

parameters.name: unit_cost
parameters.description: Unit cost of each feed type

parameters.name: quantity_unit
parameters.description: Common unit used for feed quantities and nutrient composition basis

variables.name: feed_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of each feed type selected

variables.name: total_cost
variables.description: Total cost of the selected feed mix

constraints.name: nonnegative_feed_quantities
constraints.description: Each feed quantity must be nonnegative.

constraints.name: minimum_nutrient_requirements
constraints.description: For every nutrient, the total amount supplied by the selected feed mix must meet or exceed the minimum required daily amount.

constraints.name: simultaneous_mix_satisfaction
constraints.description: All nutrient requirements must be satisfied by the same chosen feed mix; this is a descriptive modeling statement and does not impose an additional numerical restriction beyond the shared decision vector.
constraints.formula: \text{All nutrient constraints use the same vector } x

constraints.name: total_cost_definition
constraints.description: The total purchasing cost is determined from feed quantities and unit costs.

objectives.name: minimize_total_purchasing_cost
objectives.description: Minimize the total purchasing cost of the selected feed mix while satisfying all nutrient minimum requirements.

final_objective.description: Minimize the total purchasing cost of the feed mix while satisfying all nutrient minimum requirements. The provided objective was labeled maximize, but the problem statement clearly defines a minimum-cost blending problem, so the objective sense is corrected to minimization.
